mapper.select: select count(*) from medical_drug where status != '1' and stock <= #{threshold}
select department as department, count(*) as count from medical_diagnosis group by department order by count desc
select category as category, count(*) as count from medical_drug group by category order by count desc
select department as department, sum(cost) as totalCost, count(*) as count from medical_diagnosis group by department order by totalCost desc
select DATE_FORMAT(visit_date, '%Y-%m') as month, sum(cost) as totalCost, count(*) as count from medical_diagnosis group by month order by month
select gender as gender, count(*) as count from medical_patient group by gender order by count desc

select case when TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) < 18 then '0-17岁' when TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) between 18 and 39 then '18-39岁' when TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) between 40 and 59 then '40-59岁' else '60岁及以上' end as ageGroup, count(*) as count from medical_patient where birth_date is not null group by ageGroup order by case ageGroup when '0-17岁' then 1 when '18-39岁' then 2 when '40-59岁' then 3 else 4 end
